subject: Pen test: scope change (SSO/S3) + evidence & retest schedule
messages:
From: RedTeam Labs <redteam@pentestlabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenWave Health SecOps <secops@greenwavehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pen test scope question — SSO and S3 inclusion

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the kickoff on Friday. We reviewed the initial scope and have a quick clarification: the GreenWave environment you gave us access to includes a recently deployed SAML SSO integration (AuthCorp) and a set of customer-uploaded files in an S3 bucket behind the Redwood ingestion pipeline.

Per our standard methodology, we treat both SSO flows and object storage that holds PHI-like content as in-scope if the customer-facing surface can reach them. To avoid surprises in the final report, we propose the following small scope addendum:

- Add: SAML assertion flows for web login (AuthCorp IdP) — simulated assertion replay and SSO session fixation checks.
- Add: One S3 bucket (greenwave-uploads-prod) for unauthenticated object enumeration and presigned URL abuse testing.
- Exclude: Back-end cold storage (archival S3) and internal admin-only buckets unless you explicitly want them tested.

We can run these tests during the same window if you can provide:
1) A short-lived service account for S3 read/list (expires after test window) OR a signed presigned URL generator endpoint we can call.
2) A test AuthCorp SP/IdP test tenant or temporary assertion generator credentials so we can exercise SAML flows without touching production IdP settings.

Proposed retest window (if addendum accepted): Dec 18–20 UTC with a preferred kickoff on Dec 18 16:00 UTC. Estimated additional effort: +1.5 days, final consolidated report delivery 3 business days after testing.

Attached: redteam_scope_addendum_v2.pdf (summary of tests to be added).

Let us know if any of that is a hard no and we’ll scope accordingly.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Engagement Lead — RedTeam Labs
redteam@pentestlabs.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: RedTeam Labs <redteam@pentestlabs.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, GreenWave Health SecOps <secops@greenwavehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test scope question — SSO and S3 inclusion

Samir — thanks for the clear addendum. We want to include the SAML SSO flow and the customer uploads S3 bucket in-scope. A couple of constraints from our side:

- We cannot provide production IdP admin credentials. We can stand up a test SP binding and provide an assertion generator endpoint that issues signed assertions against a test SP.
- For S3, security prefers ephemeral IAM credentials scoped to list/get on the specific bucket rather than handing out long-lived keys. We can generate those with a 48-hour TTL.

Hannah / Jonas — can you confirm we can provision the ephemeral IAM role and the test SP by EOD Dec 16? If not, what timeline do you need?

If we can get both by Dec 16, the Dec 18 kickoff works. If not, propose the backup window Dec 21–22.

Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: RedTeam Labs <redteam@pentestlabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenWave Health SecOps <secops@greenwavehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 00:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test scope question — SSO and S3 inclusion

On Tue, 15 Dec 2026 at 11:03, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com> wrote:

>
> - We cannot provide production IdP admin credentials. We can stand up a test SP binding and provide an assertion generator endpoint that issues signed assertions against a test SP.
> - For S3, security prefers ephemeral IAM credentials scoped to list/get on the specific bucket rather than handing out long-lived keys. We can generate those with a 48-hour TTL.

Thanks — that approach works for us. Confirming: we will accept the test SP assertion generator and ephemeral IAM credentials. Two quick asks to make the testing efficient:

1) Please provide the expected user roles and any IP allowlist the SP imposes so we can craft realistic assertion profiles.
2) For the S3 bucket, if there are any presigned-url generating lambdas or ingestion endpoints, flag those explicitly so we can test their surfaces.

We still aim for kickoff Dec 18 16:00 UTC; please send the access details to redteam@pentestlabs.com and cc me directly when available.

Samir

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, RedTeam Labs <redteam@pentestlabs.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, GreenWave Health SecOps <secops@greenwavehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test scope question — SSO and S3 inclusion

Jordan / Samir — quick update from infra/security on provisioning: we will deliver the following by EOD Dec 16 (ETA slipped to Dec 17 due to an approval queue, apologies):

- Ephemeral IAM role for redteam@pentestlabs.com with List/Get on greenwave-uploads-prod, TTL = 48 hours.
- Test SP binding and an assertion-generator endpoint (AuthCorp test tenant) that issues signed SAML responses for three roles: user/readonly, uploader, admin.
- A shortlist of presigned-url generating lambdas and ingestion endpoints; well mark which are internal-only.

Access model and rules (excerpt):
- All external testers must authenticate via our bastion (jump.redwood.com) using ephemeral SSH certs; no direct node-level credentials will be issued.
- S3 access must be proxied through the temporary IAM role; no permanent keys.
- All test activity will be logged and telemetry snapshots will be exported to the audit bucket for retention.

Attached is the internal playbook: pt-access-playbook.pdf (includes Jumpbox steps, SSH cert request command, allowed IP ranges, and emergency kill-switch instructions).

Jonas — Im leaving the kill-switch and log export knobs to you. Please confirm that the following audit outputs will be available during the test window:
- VPC flow logs for ELB and NAT gateways (30-minute granularity)
- S3 server access logs for greenwave-uploads-prod
- AuthCorp assertion logs (AuthN events) for the test tenant

Thanks — I will send the ephemeral cred request form and the drive folder link after Jonas confirms.

— Hannah
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, RedTeam Labs <redteam@pentestlabs.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, GreenWave Health SecOps <secops@greenwavehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test scope question — SSO and S3 inclusion

Hannah — confirmed. Audit outputs will be available and the export pipeline has been primed for the test period (Dec 18 16:00 UTC start). To summarize the handoff items we uploaded to the shared Drive:

- redwood_vpc_network_diagram.pdf
- presigned-lambdas-inventory.csv (redacted)
- authcorp-test-tenant-assertion-samples.txt
- ephemeral-iam-roles-manifest.json (contains role ARNs and TTLs)

Samir / RedTeam — ephemeral creds and the assertion-generator endpoint are live. Weve posted the access instructions and keys (one-time) to the Drive folder and emailed redteam@pentestlabs.com directly with the access token.

Next steps:
- RedTeam to execute tests Dec 18–19 UTC.
- RedTeam to send preliminary findings by end of day Dec 19 so we can triage high-severity items immediately.
- Final consolidated report due Dec 23 (per earlier estimate). If you need a faster turnaround for executive-facing deliverables, raise it now and well try to prioritize.

Jonas Weber
Director, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference
